Every still rendered a live canvas with a clean console.

Line ink must stay at least 6/255 below the stock in the SAME window at the dark beat.
Printed lettering, measured as the darkest pixel inside each font rect against that rect own adjacent stock, must stay below it across enough boxes.

Reference only: the lit hold is the bright end of the same measurement chain.
Full-tier finish needs headed Chrome on D3D11; a downgraded tier or a stale sheet matrix invalidates the finish reading, not the numbers.
